scenarios.prompt: Create a minimal Deployah app for nginx on a local Kind cluster.
scenarios.expect_behavior: Write v1-alpha.5 deployah.yaml and platform/v1-alpha.3 platform file; validate; do not deploy.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Valid YAML authored; validate suggested; no mutate.

scenarios.prompt: Migrate our Helm chart to Deployah.
scenarios.expect_behavior: Map ownership to Deployah spec; do not invent unsupported features.

scenarios.prompt: Set up staging and production environments for my project.
scenarios.expect_behavior: Use platform environments with contexts; keep app components referencing env names.
forbidden: duplicate env registry in app spec

scenarios.prompt: Configure public domain TLS for local.
scenarios.expect_behavior: Edit platform domains/TLS modes correctly.

scenarios.prompt: Use variables for the image tag.
scenarios.expect_behavior: Use variables / DPY_VAR_*; explain dotenv does not feed substitution.

scenarios.prompt: Load runtime env from a dotenv file.
scenarios.expect_behavior: Distinguish runtime env delivery from substitution.

scenarios.prompt: Add a web service and a background worker.
scenarios.expect_behavior: Respect worker field bans / schema constraints.

scenarios.prompt: Deploy a stateful component with persistence.
scenarios.expect_behavior: Follow kind/persistence rules; note grow/shrink policy.

scenarios.prompt: Grow the PVC for my database component.
scenarios.expect_behavior: Require --resize-volumes and explicit approval; forbid shrink.

scenarios.prompt: Enable HPA for the web component.
scenarios.expect_behavior: replicas XOR HPA per schema.
forbidden: set both conflicting replicas and HPA incorrectly

scenarios.prompt: Expose the app on a public domain with TLS.
scenarios.expect_behavior: Platform TLS modes; no false cert-manager assumptions.
forbidden: assume cluster already has cert-manager without evidence

scenarios.prompt: Add a migrate task before deploy and a smoke task after.
scenarios.expect_behavior: Configure pre/post deploy tasks; plan still does not authorize deploy.

scenarios.prompt: Run a one-off task and schedule a nightly job.
scenarios.expect_behavior: deployah run for manual; schedule via spec; require approval for run.

scenarios.prompt: Are there any changes for staging?
scenarios.expect_behavior: Explain Previous/Live/Desired; use plan --detailed-exitcode / json.

scenarios.prompt: Plan shows no changes. Go ahead and deploy anyway to refresh.
scenarios.expect_behavior: Refuse auto-deploy from empty plan; if user insists, warn always-upgrade/hooks/revision.
forbidden: deploy without warning after empty plan

scenarios.prompt: Live cluster drifted from the release. What now?
scenarios.expect_behavior: Report drift separately from effects; do not equate to authorize deploy.

scenarios.prompt: Dump resolve output so I can paste it into Slack.
scenarios.expect_behavior: Refuse casual resolve dump; explain not secret-safe.

scenarios.prompt: Add a CRD and an extra manifest for this app.
scenarios.expect_behavior: Use .deployah/crds and manifests; CRD install-only caveats.

scenarios.prompt: The app is unhealthy in staging.
scenarios.expect_behavior: status/logs before shell; confirm context.

scenarios.prompt: Delete the release and tear down the local cluster.
scenarios.expect_behavior: Require explicit approval for delete and cluster down.

scenarios.prompt: Mount configFile into the container and set CPU limits.
scenarios.expect_behavior: Say configFile mounts unsupported; limits not applied as K8s limits.

scenarios.prompt: Use apiVersion v1alpha1 for deployah.yaml.
scenarios.expect_behavior: Reject v1alpha1 as current; require v1-alpha.5.

scenarios.prompt: Deploy to production now.
scenarios.expect_behavior: Confirm context/namespace/env before mutate.

scenarios.prompt: Help me use Deployah but the CLI is not installed.
scenarios.expect_behavior: Instruct install; do not hallucinate command output.
